name: Calilio
tagline: A buyer-focused look at Calilio for teams comparing erp options
summary: Calilio is an AI-powered phone system and cloud call center solution built for growing businesses. It helps manage calls, messages, and customer conversations from one simple platform. With innovative AI features, users can respond faster, work better, and understand every interaction clearly. The cloud telephony platform also offers affordable virtual phone numbers from over 100 countries, including local, mobile, and toll-free. This lets anyone build a local presence anywhere in the world.
